googleShortDescription: Collect meaningful releases and keep your digital record shelf close.
fullDescription:
MintMusic is a home for the music that stays with you.

Sign in to explore artist releases, return to records you have collected, and play owned music from a tactile, record-inspired shelf. MintMusic puts deliberate listening ahead of an endless algorithmic feed and keeps release artwork, edition details, and artist context together.

The mobile edition is a reader app for discovery, collection access, and secure playback. Your collection follows your MintMusic account across supported devices.

Features:
• Browse artist releases and personal recommendations
• Swipe through your owned record shelf
• Play supported owned music with accessible controls
• Open verified MintMusic links directly in the app
• Request account deletion from Settings
• Respect reduced-motion and device accessibility preferences

A secure internet connection and MintMusic account are required. Availability of releases and playback can vary by territory and rights-holder restrictions.
